theorem zero_sum_boundG (hp : PolyDatum f B κ)
    (hcls : ∀ T : ℝ, ∀ u ∈ zerosRectD f T, f u = 0 ∧ (u = 0 ∨ (0 < u.re ∧ u.re < 1)))
    {T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : 50 ≤ T0)
    (hG : ∀ ρ : ℂ, f ρ = 0 → 0 < ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 → |ρ.im| ≤ T0 → ρ.re = 1 / 2)
    (M : ℂ → ℂ) {G0 : ℝ} (hM0 : ‖M 0‖ ≤ G0)
    {F F' : ℝ → ℂ} (hMF : ∀ t : ℝ, M (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I) = F t)
    (hF : ∀ t, HasDerivAt F (F' t) t) (hF' : Continuous F')
    {Q1 Q2 : ℝ} (hQ1 : 0 < Q1) (hQ2 : 0 < Q2)
    (hF2 : Integrable fun t => ‖F t‖ ^ 2) (hF2' : Integrable fun t => ‖F' t‖ ^ 2)
    (hFQ : ∫ t, ‖F t‖ ^ 2 ≤ Q1) (hFQ' : ∫ t, ‖F' t‖ ^ 2 ≤ Q2)
    {EB' EA' ρB ρA : ℝ} (hEB : 0 ≤ EB') (hEA : 0 ≤ EA') (hρB0 : 0 ≤ ρB) (hρB1 : ρB < 1)
    (hρA0 : 0 ≤ ρA) (hρA1 : ρA < 1)
    (htail : ∀ s : ℂ, 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → T0 < |s.im| →
      ‖M s‖ ≤ EB' * ρB ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ + EA' * ρA ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (T : ℝ) :
    ‖∑ u ∈ zerosRectD f T, (multRectD f T u : ℂ) * (M u * (x : ℂ) ^ u)‖ ≤
      G0 * Z3g B 0 + √x * E1g B T0 Q1 Q2 + x * E2g B κ T0 EB' EA' ρB ρA :=

note: Lean replaces the lemma with a zero-by-zero tail bound and Jensen-window zero counts, at H = 200. Erratum: The proof's step (9.66) rests on Lemma 9.1.3's decreasing-f clause, which drops f(T₀)g_χ(T₀); for ζ at H = 25, T₀ = 75, δ → 0 the zero sum Σ_{γ>75}f(γ) = 0.07975 exceeds (9.66)'s right side 0.06752, and with the term restored the method needs 94.28 (q = 1, H = 25, T₀ = 75), 70.28 (q = 3), 68.52 (q = 1, H = 200, T₀ = 250) and 27.5–27.8 at §9.6's heights instead of 11.308.
